summary: Backend-only testing after role-based auth (Emergent Google Sign-in) + date-based rentals. 31 pytest cases covering public routes, /api/auth/me + logout, USER/ADMIN role gating for all admin endpoints, blocked-user 403, rental creation (days & total math, invalid date, unavailable tool, no auth), user isolation (list/cancel/pay across two users), admin tool CRUD + delete-with-active-rentals guard, admin approve flip, and admin block user. Sessions bootstrapped via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md. All 31 tests PASSED (100%).

minor.issue: Pydantic RentalCreate has date type but end_date < start_date check happens after `max(1, days+1)` fallback would silently accept — currently guarded correctly with explicit 400, but consider also validating start_date is not in the past.
Uses query param `rental_id` on a POST (unusual). Works, but a JSON body would be more idiomatic and consistent with other payment endpoints.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 744 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting auth, payments, and admin into separate routers/modules for maintainability.
storage_put/storage_get use blocking `requests` inside async handlers — this will block the event loop under load. Switch to httpx.AsyncClient or run in a threadpool.
admin_upload_tool_image sets image_url to a relative path (/api/files/...) — frontend must prefix with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified this is intentional but worth documenting.

GET /api/files/{path} has no auth or rate-limit and returns arbitrary storage content — currently keyed by an entry in tool_files, which is fine, but ensure only image content-types are ever served (defence in depth).

Session token for authenticated users is taken directly from Emergent's response (`data.get('session_token')`) with a UUID fallback. Fine, but no explicit rotation on re-login could allow stale tokens to accumulate. Not a blocker.
test_credentials: Sessions bootstrapped programmatically via mongosh (see /app/auth_testing.md). ADMIN_EMAIL=arpitchoudhary1911@gmail.com in backend/.env. Tests create TEST_* prefixed users and clean them up per class.
seed_data_creation: Test users/sessions are created and torn down by fixtures. Seed tools (4) come from server.py startup. No manual seed required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_rbac.py — reuses mongosh-based session bootstrap. Fixtures TEST_* prefix all test data and clean up in teardown. Public endpoints (tools, payments/methods, payments/webhook) verified auth-free. All admin endpoints gated by current_admin. USER data-scoping (rentals list/cancel/pay) verified. Blocked-user 403 verified. Rental math verified: days=(end-start)+1, total=days*daily_rate. Backend fully green.
